response: {"thought": "依語意層定義，取消率 = 已取消(9) ÷ (狀態 1、2、3、9)，待付款(0)不入分母，期間依 order_ts 歸屬。先直接計算 2025 年 8 月 store 通路的結果，並同時回傳分子與分母以便檢查。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) AS cancelled, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN order_id END) AS denom, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN order_id END), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE channel = 'store' AND order_ts >= '2025-08-01' AND order_ts < '2025-09-01'"}}
